doc_title_en: (Supplemental) Notice Regarding Board Approval Opinion and Shareholder Application Recommendation for Public Tender Offer by LLC VIC for Dentsu Soken Stock
doc_title_jp: （追加）合同会社VICによる当社株式に対する公開買付けの開始予定に関する賛同の意見表明及び応募推奨に関するお知らせ
summary_en: Dentsu Soken board special committee unanimously recommends shareholders accept public tender offer by LLC VIC (Dentsu Group parent affiliate). Tender intended to be followed by stock consolidation to make Dentsu Soken wholly owned by VIC and Dentsu Group. Committee conducted 19 meetings (approx. 28 hours) from June 5 to August 28, 2026, affirming transaction purpose, pricing fairness, procedural integrity, and shareholder protection.
summary_jp: 電通総研の特別委員会が、親会社電通グループ関係の合同会社VICによる公開買付けへの応募を全会一致で推奨。買付け後に株式併合で完全子会社化予定。委員会は2026年6月5日～8月28日に19回開催し、取引の正当性・公正性を確認。

summary_en: LLC VIC (80% Itochu, 20% IFP) to launch public tender offer for all outstanding Dentsu Soken shares with board recommendation to accept. Tender expected to commence early Nov 2026, subject to completion of antitrust clearances in Japan, China, and EU (all targeted for completion by Nov 2026). Post-tender, VIC and Dentsu Group to hold 38.22% and 61.78% of voting shares respectively; delisting expected. Special committee established to reaffirm fairness assessment at launch.
summary_jp: 合同会社VIC（伊藤忠80%、IFP 20%）による公開買付。取締役会が推奨。2026年11月上旬開始予定。日本・中国・EU競争法クリアランス取得必須。買付後、VICと電通グループが各38.22%・61.78%保有。上場廃止予定。特別委員会が開始時に意見を再確認。
